uncited: Unlike static methods that assume rigid geometry, this family solves the problem of rendering articulated bodies with moving poses and expressions from limited input views (monocular or sparse multi-view).
Early works like [NeuMan](12480-neuman.md) and [Neural Body](12176-neural-body.md) introduced parametric models (SMPL) to guide deformation.
Facial modeling was addressed by [NeRF with Per-Frame Latent Codes](12042-nerf-with-per-frame-latent-codes.md) using blendshapes and latent codes.
